# Support hours

Managers normally review customer-support requests Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 local time, excluding public holidays. The automated assistant can provide documented information outside those hours.

Messages submitted after hours remain queued until the next support period. These hours do not guarantee a response deadline. Urgent safety concerns involving unstable or damaged furniture should include clear details and should not involve continued use of the item while awaiting review.
